subject.title: fix(media): gate inbound audio on structured media facts

question: Should maintainers accept the deliberate removal of legacy placeholder and filename audio inference after confirming that every supported ingress path supplies structured audio facts?
rationale: This is a core-to-plugin contract change with a protected `maintainer` label; source tests can show individual cases but cannot determine whether the repository accepts the compatibility boundary across all bundled channels.

options.title: Approve structured-only contract
options.body: Accept the contract after reviewing the bundled-channel producer audit and a redacted runtime proof for the Discord fallback path.

options.title: Retain a temporary migration path
options.body: Keep a narrowly defined compatibility or migration mechanism only if maintainers identify a shipped ingress that cannot yet provide structured media facts.

recommendation.title: Approve structured-only contract
recommendation.body: Accept the contract after reviewing the bundled-channel producer audit and a redacted runtime proof for the Discord fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the proposed media-contract and Discord producer changes and is the closest available routing candidate in the supplied history.
